verdict.rationale: Check is an embedded payroll API, so configuring multiple pay schedules is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only covers creating, previewing and approving payroll objects, plus workplaces and employees. Nothing documents pay-schedule objects, weekly, biweekly, semimonthly or monthly frequencies, or assigning different schedules to different teams, and generic payroll-run docs are an adjacent capability that earns no credit here.
